title: lore sync logs a branch's UNMERGED docs commits as landings, and re-adds them on every run
description:
Filed from opum-cli's finding (opum-cli#392).

`lore sync` writes `docs/log.md` lines for the CURRENT BRANCH's latest docs commit even when that commit is UNMERGED, and it writes them with no `(#N)` pull-request reference. In opum-cli#392 it recorded TWO of the PR's own commits as landings, and every subsequent `lore sync` RE-ADDS them, so deleting the lines by hand does not survive the next sync.

The log should record only commits that have LANDED on the default/integration branch. As measured, the entry is emitted from the branch tip's own history rather than from the integration branch, so any branch ahead of `dev`/`main` logs its own unmerged commits as though they had landed — and because the line is regenerated rather than carried, a manual correction is undone on the next run.

HELD, no code, tracker-only filing.
